fnol_text: My name is Rafael Khan and I live at 407 Linden Terrace, Fairview, PA 16443. You can reach me on (555) 870-5717 or rafael.khan@example.com. On 15 March 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00001. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Khan on (555) 870-5717 to acknowledge the claim. Rafael confirmed the loss date as 15 March 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Rosa Thorne gave a statement by phone.
Rafael sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
